premises.quote: “Premises” means Unit 4, Oakridge Business Park, 12 Sample Road, Sampleton, measuring approximately 412 m² (four hundred and twelve square metres), as shown on the plan in Schedule 1;

endDate.quote: “Lease Period” means the period commencing on the Commencement Date and ending on 31 January 2027, both days inclusive, and “Expiry Date” means the last day of that period;

termMonths.quote: This lease shall endure for the Lease Period, being a period of 3 (three) years.

renewal.quote: The Tenant shall have the option to renew this lease for a further period of 3 (three) years on terms to be agreed.

notice.quote: The Tenant shall exercise the option by written notice to the Landlord given not less than two calendar months before the Expiry Date.

With effect from the date of signature of this addendum, clause 18.2 of the Lease is deleted and replaced with the following: “18.2 The Tenant shall exercise the option by written notice to the Landlord given not less than three calendar months before expiry of this lease.”

feeChange.quote:
The monthly Rent, excluding VAT, payable in terms of clause 5 is as follows:

deposit.quote: Before taking occupation, the Tenant shall pay the Landlord a deposit equal to two months' Rent at the rate applicable in the final year of the Lease Period, being R64 000.00 (sixty-four thousand rand).
